user.title: Choose two measurement sources
user.description: Choose total power at the grid connection and a cumulative meter counting only grid imports. The list is narrowed by units and state class; it cannot reliably distinguish grid, solar, household or daily meters. You confirm the physical meaning. Custom sensors without a device class are supported with matching units. No devices are controlled.

data_description.power_sensor: W or kW; entire grid connection, not solar, household load or a single phase.
data_description.energy_sensor: Wh/kWh/MWh; grid imports only, cumulative, no regular reset.

settings.title: Confirm direction and target
settings.description: Check during independently known grid import: does the power sensor show positive or negative? Do not infer this from its current sign alone: solar and batteries can export. The target is your desired fixed-quarter average, not a tariff limit or a device command. Once finished, open Peak Monitor (Netzspitzen) in the sidebar.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Default 120 seconds: adjust only to the verified reporting interval. Polling does not refresh old values. Enter resolution only if known, e.g. 0.01 kWh = 10 Wh; 0 does not estimate resolution and keeps strict energy report age checks.

data.energy_resolution_kwh: Known meter resolution (0 = unknown / strict age limit)

reconfigure.title: Change measurement sources
reconfigure.description: Choose new sensors for this monitor. Its entities and your personal target are retained. Changing sources starts a new local history and monthly peak; the previous history is backed up locally first. Confirm the change in the next step. Use Configure to change the target or report age.

data_description.power_sensor: W or kW; entire grid connection, not solar, household load or a single phase.
data_description.energy_sensor: Wh/kWh/MWh; grid imports only, cumulative, no regular reset.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Confirm source change
reconfigure_confirm.description: Saving switches the measurement sources. The previous history remains in a local backup and is no longer used in the active display; there is no restore interface yet. Entities are retained. Confirm the import direction again during actual grid import. A new energy meter initially resets known resolution to 0: check the correct resolution and reporting interval under Advanced. Measurements restart with the next complete quarter hour.
